name: Trip to Paradise
source:
You are Chris, a game designer and company owner, celebrating the success of his latest project by going on a cruise with his best friend and his fianceé, his beautiful co-worker and her barmaid, sex-bomb friend. Boy, do we envy you.

You will need to be careful about your interactions with your female companions. There’s a line between love and hate, but also one between lust and rage. The game’s all about crossing lines.

[From [url=http://lopgold.com/index_ttp.php]Official site[/url]]
translation:
你是游戏设计师兼公司老板Chris，正与最好的朋友、朋友的未婚妻、漂亮的女同事以及她那位性感火辣的酒吧女友乘坐游轮，庆祝最新项目成功。真让人羡慕。

你必须谨慎处理与女性同伴的关系。爱与恨之间有一条界线，欲望与愤怒之间也有一条。游戏的主题，就是跨越这些界线。

（来源：[url=http://lopgold.com/index_ttp.php]官方网站[/url]）
